stem: What is most likely the reason the poet compares spitting cherry pits to playing baseball?

options.label: F
options.text: To show that spitting cherry pits is just as much a team sport as baseball

options.label: G
options.text: To help the reader relate a well-known activity to an activity that might be unfamiliar

options.label: H
options.text: To explain that less time is required for spitting cherry pits than for playing baseball

options.label: J
options.text: To show the reader that some activities are more interesting than others
